name: Five primary branches and three side branches, with no RNG draws
Branches lock before Moon, free outpost installs at Moon once
Half-bar and full-bar points award exactly once, including mass loss and route switches
Research Centre costs exactly 25 raw and batches use 50 raw over 18 seconds
Adaptations spend AP alone while engineering spends RP with rank and time escalation
Laser prerequisites require optics, attack laser and two miners
Mining fractures real rock, conserves its mass and produces finite carried ore
An actual drone travels, cuts and returns ore under physical gravity
Collectors pick up real raw crates and deposit them at the moving station
Weapons dislodge real rival mass into debris without duplication
Turrets and lasers have bounded real hits and finite raw debris
Batteries charge, pause machines and then power an overclock at an inverse duration tradeoff
Generation progresses from turbine to fission, fusion, solar and Dyson, each with prerequisites
Shield storage absorbs bounded damage and recharges only when powered and safe
Water and DNA recovery use fractional carry without changing rarity odds
In-progress research, drone cargo, shields, resource carries, claims and power timers survive reload
Save schema rejects malformed industry payloads and still accepts pre-update runs
Sandbox exposes all remnant classes and mass edits use the exact current mass unit
Journey mode blocks Sandbox routes, resource grants and mass edits
Late-game fields consist of systems and asteroid belts with physical orbital velocities
Every installed upgrade adds visible machinery, followers toggle, and rendering freezes when paused
Twenty restarts leave no duplicated loops, listeners, drones, shots or salvage
